sections.Profile:
Theatre of Magic, released by Bally in 1995, is a captivating pinball machine designed by John Popadiuk. The game immerses players in a world of illusions, where they must perform eight distinct magic tricks to progress. Notable features include a prominent bash toy called "The Magic Trunk," which activates various game modes and multiball, as well as magnets and elaborate ramps that enhance gameplay dynamics.
